mcqs.q: Which cat personality dimension was correlated with inappropriate urination after adoption?
mcqs.e: The 'soliciting' dimension correlated with inappropriate urination (P=0.008).

mcqs.q: What was a leading post-adoption uncertainty reported by guardians?
o: How to introduce the new cat to other animals
mcqs.e: Half of guardians (50.4%) were unsure how to introduce the new cat to resident animals.

mcqs.q: Households where a resident disliked the adopted cat were correlated with which cat trait?
mcqs.e: A resident disliking the cat was correlated with the cat's young age (P=0.014).

journal: Journal of Applied Animal Behaviour Science

mcqs.q: Which enrichment produced significantly lower faecal glucocorticoid metabolites and higher food intake than controls?
mcqs.e: Cats with a hiding box (BOX) had lower FGM and ate more daily than CTRL cats.

mcqs.q: How did shy cats compare with bold cats in stress response?
mcqs.e: Shy cats had higher CSS on days 1-3 and were more likely to score CSS >=3.

mcqs.q: What was the trend in stress responses across the 10-day study?
mcqs.e: The authors concluded caging stress diminished with time.

mcqs.q: When an unfamiliar human was present (vs. audio alone), shelter dogs did what?
o: Spent more time in their bed and looked at the audio source
Hid in the back of the enclosure
mcqs.e: Dogs spent more time in their bed and looking at the auditory source when a human was present.

mcqs.q: What did the authors conclude human presence may induce in some animals?
o: Frustration from inability to physically interact
mcqs.e: Human presence increased interest but may cause frustration from not being able to physically interact.

mcqs.q: During audio-only stimulation (no human), cats tended to spend more time where?
o: Vertical dimension where hiding boxes were located
mcqs.e: Cats tended to use the vertical dimension (hiding box area) during audio without a human present.

journal: Journal of Applied Animal Welfare Science

mcqs.q: Capacity for Care (C4C) manages shelter intake primarily using what?
o: Intake waitlists and scheduled intake appointments
mcqs.e: A key C4C feature is managing intake via waitlists and scheduled appointments.

mcqs.q: Cats whose owners cited which primary reason were more often kept rather than relinquished?
mcqs.e: Cats with veterinary issues as the surrender reason were more often kept by owners.

mcqs.q: A greater proportion of cats were surrendered when the owner had what?
mcqs.e: Cats whose owners had medical issues were more often surrendered than retained.

mcqs.q: Of the 82 publications screened, how many contained appropriate generic QoL assessment tools?
mcqs.e: Nine publications met inclusion criteria for generic QoL tools.

mcqs.q: How many of the nine QoL tools were validated across all reliability and validity measures?
mcqs.e: None of the tools were validated across all measures.

mcqs.q: Which items were common QoL indicators for both dogs and cats?
o: Activity level, desire for interaction, and appetite
mcqs.e: Common items for both species included activity level, desire for interaction, and appetite.

mcqs.q: The Welfare through Competence framework combines the Five Domains model with which model?
mcqs.e: The framework merges the Five Domains model with the Coe Individual Competence model.

mcqs.q: Whom does the framework aim to center as stakeholders in technology design?
mcqs.e: Animal-Computer Interaction centers animals as stakeholders in design.

mcqs.q: The framework responds to a methodological gap in which field?
mcqs.e: It addresses the need for robust animal-centered methods in Animal-Computer Interaction.

mcqs.q: The buccal micronucleus assay was used to measure what in shelter versus family animals?
mcqs.e: The assay quantified stress-associated genomic damage via micronuclei in buccal cells.

mcqs.q: Compared with family pets, shelter cats and dogs showed what micronuclei frequency?
mcqs.e: Shelter animals had significantly higher micronuclei frequency, indicating more genomic damage.

mcqs.q: Was genomic damage significantly correlated with the animals' age or sex?
mcqs.e: No significant differences by sex and no age correlation were found.

mcqs.q: Which housing condition produced the highest frequency of displacement (stress) behaviors?
mcqs.e: Dogs housed alone in a cage showed the highest displacement activity.

mcqs.q: What condition best reduced stress and faecal cortisol metabolites?
mcqs.e: Conspecific presence reduced both displacement activity and faecal cortisol metabolites.

mcqs.q: Faecal cortisol metabolites were used as a non-invasive measure of what?
mcqs.e: Faecal cortisol metabolites index adrenocortical activity, a marker of stress.

mcqs.q: How many basic emotional systems does the review describe in mammals?
mcqs.e: Seven basic emotional systems were described in mammals.

mcqs.q: Behavior is coordinated by which system processing internal and external stimuli?
mcqs.e: The central nervous system coordinates the responses underlying behavior.

mcqs.q: The review highlights interaction between which two process types influencing behavior?
mcqs.e: It examines interplay of primary (innate) and secondary (learned) processes.

mcqs.q: The authors recommend short-term accommodation be limited to what time frame?
mcqs.e: They argue precautionary short-term housing should stay within one circadian cycle (<24 h).

mcqs.q: At 24 hours or more, how should animals be accommodated?
o: Under long-term housing, husbandry, and best practices
mcqs.e: At >=24 h, conditions should match long-term housing best practices.

mcqs.q: How did the authors characterize English Government guidance on these terms?
o: Highly inconsistent and lacking scientific rationale
mcqs.e: Government guidance ranged widely (<1 day to 3 months) and lacked scientific rationale.

mcqs.q: The study recruited residents of zip codes with a high rate of what?
mcqs.e: Participants lived in 12 LA County zip codes with high kitten shelter intake.

mcqs.q: What were the most prevalent concerns about fostering kittens?
mcqs.e: Time (79%), cost (78%), and space (77%) were the top reported concerns.

mcqs.q: Compared with expectation, Spanish-language participants were how likely to have seen foster program ads?
mcqs.e: Spanish-language respondents were significantly less likely to have encountered ads.

journal: Journal of Applied Animal Welfare Science

mcqs.q: Compared with the public, professionals gave kenneled-dog welfare scores that were?
mcqs.e: Professionals gave slightly lower (poorer) welfare scores than the public (p=0.046).

mcqs.q: Shelter employees and professionals more often used what to justify their welfare scores?
mcqs.e: Both expert groups cited body language and behavior more than the public did.

mcqs.q: What improvement did all three groups commonly propose for welfare?
mcqs.e: All three populations mentioned adding enrichment, though experts did so more often.
